recipe.visualDefinition: A high-impact graphic composition featuring a vibrant red field framing a central 2x2 grid of black-and-white portraits, topped by heavy, stacked sans-serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Red background acts as a unified frame for monochrome imagery
Stacked typography creates a heavy visual header
Thin black lines separate the four photographic quadrants
High-contrast black and white photos provide a tonal break from the saturated red

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four cropped portraits occupy the central horizontal band in a balanced grid.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large white and black text blocks at the top serve as the primary entry point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down flow: Header text leads to the grid of faces, ending with small metadata at the bottom corners.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Generous red margins at the top and bottom create a letterbox effect.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Saturated red background provides high energy and brand identity.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black and white photography provides a neutral, classic contrast.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White text highlights the primary subject name against the red.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation background vs. zero saturation imagery creates a modern-retro tension.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Ultra-bold, condensed sans-serif and heavy slab-influenced sans.
letterConstructionRules: Heavy stroke weights with minimal counters
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Stacking different weights and slants of the same or similar heavy sans-serif families.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the ultra-bold, condensed verticality of the main name.
Captures the aggressive lean of the top sub-header.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a solid red canvas. In the center, place a 2x2 grid of four different black-and-white close-up portraits of a man with 70s-style hair. Separate the photos with thin black lines. Leave significant red space at the top and bottom.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three lines of text at the top: first line in black italicized bold sans-serif, second line in white ultra-bold condensed sans-serif, third line in black ultra-bold sans-serif. Add small white serif text in the bottom left and a bold white logo-style font in the bottom right.

verificationChecks: Is the red background vibrant and solid?
Are the photos strictly black and white?
Is the text tracking tight enough that letters almost touch?
Is the grid perfectly centered horizontally?

postGenerationChecks: Check for text legibility against red
Ensure grid lines are sharp and black
recipe.reuseFormula: Saturated Red Field + 2x2 B&W Grid + Stacked Ultra-Bold Sans-Serif Header
